headline: Italian Industry and Services Turnover Rose in September 2026
summary: In September 2026, Italy's calendar-adjusted industry turnover index rose 5.6% year-over-year in value. The turnover index for services increased by 5.3% in value.
why: Turnover indices track overall business activity and nominal demand across key sectors of the Italian economy.

impacts.name: Italy
impacts.why: Higher industrial and service turnover reflects broader revenue growth within the domestic economy.
